jobs.title: Healthcare Tech Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Role:
Technical Solutions Engineer

Responsibilities

Diagnose and resolve complex software issues affecting healthcare systems.
Collaborate with customer teams to implement effective solutions.
Provide technical support to ensure optimal system performance.

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor's degree required.
Willingness to travel occasionally.
Eligibility to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship.
Willingness to relocate to Madison, WI.

Additional Information:
The role offers comprehensive benefits, annual raises, and bonuses to support professional growth and satisfaction.

jobs.title: Ortho RN Program Coordinator - Lead Care & Innovation
jobs.description:
Role:
RN Program Coordinator responsible for leading a new Orthopedic Surgery program.

Key Responsibilities

Coordinate patient care and clinical protocols across departments.
Drive evidence-based practice and process improvements within the hospital setting.
Oversee program operations to ensure smooth functioning.
Collaborate with surgeons and OR RNs to align clinical activities.
Ensure compliance with regulatory standards and hospital policies.

Qualifications & Skills:

BSN required within four years of hire.
RN licensure required.
Strong leadership, communication, and collaborative skills.
Experience in clinical coordination and process improvement preferred.

jobs.title: Healthcare Tech Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Role:
Technical Solutions Engineer

Responsibilities

Develop and manage impactful healthcare software solutions that benefit millions of patients
Handle complex technical issues and provide effective resolutions
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful implementation and support of software products
Engage in occasional travel and relocate to Madison, WI, with reimbursement

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor's degree required
Strong problem-solving and technical skills
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
Adaptability to travel and relocation requirements

Additional Details:
The role offers comprehensive benefits, a merit-based salary, and a commitment to diversity and inclusion.
